name: gaps2-naalu-agent-home
description: Z'eu (Naalu agent, Prophecy of Kings; audit-gaps-2, gate TI4_RULES_LEADERS). Card text: 'ACTION: Exhaust this card and choose a player. That player may perform a tactical action in a non-home system without placing a command token.' The original only said 'you cannot do a tactical action in a home system this way' in its message. pbd105@152 (Naalu's turn): Naalu uses Z'eu on itself; activating its home system (310) is refused; Qucenn's system (207) is accepted. (gate38: pbd105's Naalu holds the Thunder's Edge Z'eu (naaluagent-te: 'return that token to that player's reinforcements'), not the PoK one; the base save gives Naalu the PoK naaluagent so the press names a leader it owns.)
